content: Absolutely fantastic stay! The staff was incredibly friendly and helpful, the room was spotless, and the breakfast was delicious. Highly recommend!
Nice hotel, a bit dated in some areas but overall a good value for the price. The location was perfect for exploring the city.
Disappointing experience. The room was noisy, the air conditioning didn't work properly, and the service was slow. Not worth the money.
Amazing hotel! Beautiful views, luxurious amenities, and exceptional service. Will definitely be back.
It was okay. Nothing special, but nothing terrible either. A standard hotel with standard amenities.
Good location, close to restaurants and attractions. The rooms were clean and comfortable. A solid choice for a short stay.
Terrible! Dirty room, rude staff, and constant noise. I wouldn't recommend this hotel to anyone.
Loved the rooftop pool and the friendly atmosphere. The hotel was well-maintained and the staff went above and beyond to make our stay enjoyable.
Convenient location near the airport. The hotel is clean and the staff are polite. A good option for travelers needing a quick overnight stay.
Decent hotel for the price. The breakfast was a bit basic, and the rooms could use some updating, but overall it was a comfortable stay.
The hotel was clean and in a good location. The breakfast buffet was a little small, but overall a pleasant experience.
Outstanding service! Everyone was so friendly and helpful. The room was spacious and well-appointed. A truly memorable stay.
Very disappointed with this hotel. The room was small and cramped, and there were several maintenance issues. Not recommended.
A comfortable and convenient hotel for business travelers. The rooms are well-equipped with a work desk and reliable Wi-Fi.
Beautiful hotel with a stunning view! The staff was exceptionally friendly and helpful. A perfect getaway.
The hotel was adequate, but nothing stood out. It met my basic needs, but lacked any special amenities or charm.
Avoid this hotel at all costs! The room was filthy, the staff were unhelpful, and the overall experience was terrible.
Absolutely loved this hotel! The decor was modern and stylish, the rooms were luxurious, and the service was impeccable.
Good value for the price. The rooms were clean and comfortable, and the location was convenient. A solid choice for budget travelers.
The hotel was okay, but a bit noisy at night. The breakfast was decent, but the rooms could use some updating.
The hotel advertised free parking but it wasn't available and there were no alternative parking options.  Room was also quite small.
Perfect for families! The hotel offered a kids' club and a great pool area. The rooms were spacious and comfortable.
A great location for exploring the city. The rooms were clean and comfortable, but the decor was a little dated.
The staff were very friendly, but the hotel felt a bit run down and the gym facilities were poor.
Loved the spa! Relaxing and rejuvenating. The room was beautiful and the staff were attentive.
Overpriced for what you get. Small rooms and poor service. Not worth the money.
The location was great and the staff were helpful. Breakfast was a bit limited.
Excellent service and a beautiful hotel!  Will definitely book again.
Average hotel.  Nothing to complain about, but nothing to rave about either.
The worst hotel experience ever! Dirty, noisy, and the staff were rude. AVOID!
